Why does my sourdough collapse?

crustcurious

My loaves rise beautifully in the basket and then collapse in the first ten minutes of baking. Starter is three weeks old and doubles reliably.

rye_and_reason
collapse in the first ten minutes of baking

That is overproofing, almost always. Try the poke test and shorten your bulk by thirty minutes. Also check your oven spring: if you open the door early, the steam escapes.

crustcurious

Shortened bulk by thirty minutes and the crumb opened up. Thank you — the poke test was the missing piece.
